Small change, big impact
Live smarter and greener with our innovative solutions—designed to conserve resources, minimise waste, and enhance durability for a more sustainable home. Explore our products and make the switch to
and enhance durability for a more sustainable home. Explore our products and make the switch to sustainable living.
Zero emissions deliveries
As delivery vehicles are a major contributor to air and noise pollution as well as congestion in cities, IKEA India has committed and already secured for more than 90% of all truck deliveries being
IKEA India has committed and already secured for more than 90% of all truck deliveries being fulfilled with EVs.
Renewable energy
Urgent action is needed to tackle climate change, which is why IKEA India to use 100% renewable energy sources for its electricity needs of our stores, warehouses and other buildings.
